title: Manifest should flag high-risk components with implementation guidance
description: Phase 2 introduces the only ML service (Scribe with VAD + Whisper). It requires model download/packaging, memory-intensive inference, and temperature fallback retries. If Scribe is unstable, it blocks IP-8→IP-12→IP-13→29 downstream features. The manifest doesn't flag this risk or recommend mitigations like mock transcription mode.
root_cause: The manifest generation step does not perform risk analysis on individual features. It assigns features to phases based on dependency ordering and balance, but doesn't identify features that are technically risky (ML, external service dependencies, resource-intensive) and flag them for early mitigation.
recommendation: Add a 'Risk Notes' or 'Implementation Guidance' subsection to Phase 3.3 manifest generation. For each phase, identify features with high technical risk (ML models, external integrations, resource-intensive operations, novel technology) and add guidance: (1) prioritize these in bootstrap, (2) recommend stub/mock modes for parallel development, (3) note downstream blast radius.
affected_phase: Phase 3.3 — Generate Phase Manifests — Phase E2E Test section
